crossRefs.note: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in…
but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son…

people.name: Baara
people.line: A wife of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.

people.name: Hushim
people.line: A son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Shaharaim
people.line: Benjamite who had wives Hushim and Baara

translations.web: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
translations.bsb: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
translations.kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
translations.asv: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
